edges.reason: _transfer sets the swapping reentrancy guard around swapBack.
tx.origin is used to gate one purchase per block, enabling phishing/origin manipulation.
block.timestamp controls early sell tax window, making fee behavior timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as liquidity add deadline to the router.
_transfer calls swapBack while tokens are being transferred.
swapBack makes a low-level call sending ETH to devWallet.
swapBack makes a low-level call sending remaining ETH to marketingWallet.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to add token/ETH liquidity.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs an external router call with ETH value.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to determine buy/sell paths.
_transfer writes _blacklist for anti-bot protection.
_transfer reads and writes _holderFirstBuyTimestamp for early sell logic.
_transfer recomputes sellTotalFees from fee components during transfer.
swapBack computes ethForDev with multiplication/division arithmetic.
swapBack computes ethForMarketing with multiplication/division arithmetic.
swapBack computes liquidityTokens with multiplication/division arithmetic.
_transfer subtracts fees from the transfer amount.

from parameter flows through transfer logic and blacklist checks.

recipients array controls transfer destinations in Chire.
values array elements are multiplied by 10**decimals in Chire.
